title: Shelf missing one panel
description: Assemble a flat-pack bookshelf. One shelf/panel is missing, the rest of the shelf is assembled.

criteria.label: Item fully assembled, no leftover parts visible
Item stands stable on a flat floor

notes: MANUAL §9.5 "missing a shelf" expects PARTIAL. Note for the eval: c2 ("All shelves/panels present and aligned") is required, so the §10 engine can also return REJECTED (required FAIL with high confidence); PARTIAL is only reachable if c2 is judged PASS/NOT_VISIBLE. Both outcomes are recorded.
